newsitem.title: USA: Honeywell names new COO, CFO.
newsitem.headline: Honeywell names new COO, CFO.

text.p: Honeywell Inc said president and chief operating officer Larry Moore will retire.
He will be replaced in both positions on April 15 by Giannantonio Ferrari, currently president of Honeywell Europe, Middle East and Africa, the company said.
In addition, the company said chief financial officer William Hjerpe will succeed Ferrari as president of Honeywell Europe, Middle East and Africa, effective March 1.
Lawrence Stranghoener will become chief financial officer, effective February 1, Honeywell said. He had been vice president of business development.
